title: Core: eye-plane view ray, target filters, Reach stat helper, view direction
player_outcome: Groundwork for P1-06: in Core, targets behind the player can no longer be selected, bushes and tree canopies stop stealing the crosshair, and the Reach stat (Builder) extends the cursor as well as the use.
design: PlayerEntity: add Vector3? ViewDirection (camera forward, set by the engine each tick), Vector3 Facing => ViewDirection ?? Aim, and float AimDistance = 40f (eye to crosshair point, metres).
PlayerEntity.FacingQuarter now uses Facing, so tests that only set Aim keep working.

Targeting: add [Flags] enum TargetFilter { None = 0, Decor = 1, TreeCanopy = 2, All = 3 } and a Cast(world, origin, dir, reachMeters, TargetFilter) overload. The existing bool overload maps to All/TreeCanopy.
In the hit predicate, objects with Def.Collision == TileCollision.Trunk count only when the cell is inside obj.TrunkBox, unless TreeCanopy is set; otherwise the DDA continues through the canopy.

Targeting.CastView(VoxelWorld world, Vector3 camera, Vector3 dir, Vector3 eye, float reachMeters, TargetFilter filter, out float startT): startT = Max(0, Dot(eye - camera, dir)); cast from camera + dir*startT over reach + |lateral offset| + 0.5 m. The returned Target.Distance is measured from the eye, so nothing between camera and player can ever be hit.
Targeting.CastWhere(world, originMeters, dir, reachMeters, Func<Int3,ushort,bool> isHit): exposes the existing private DDA for hooks and shot origins.
TileObjectInstance.TrunkBox (cell units): the central column of half-width Max(0.5, width/6) and 55% height, moved from ObjectColliders.ShapeFor. ObjectColliders now calls it (same behaviour).

ItemUseSystem: public static float ReachMeters(PlayerEntity p, ItemDef? item) = ((item?.Reach ?? 10) + p.State.Effects.Stats.Bonus(StatIds.Reach)) * Units.CellSize. Use() calls it instead of the inline formula at line 94.

ItemUseSystem: public static TargetFilter FilterFor(ItemUseInfo? info). Decor when the item has Mine/Chop/Hammer, TreeCanopy when it has Chop, None otherwise (weapons, placeables, empty hand). PlacementRules already lets decor be replaced.
MeleeSystem.Start: Yaw from Atan2(Facing.X, Facing.Z) (arc centred on the crosshair, not pulled 30-69° by the shoulder offset); Pitch stays from Aim.
CommandContext.Aim and GodotCommandHost.Aim: also set ViewDirection = dir.
files_modify: src/Strata.Core/Session/PlayerEntity.cs — ViewDirection, Facing, AimDistance, FacingQuarter via Facing
src/Strata.Core/Gameplay/Interaction/Targeting.cs — TargetFilter, CastView, CastWhere, trunk-only unless TreeCanopy
tests: TargetingTests.ViewRayIgnoresBlocksBetweenCameraAndPlayer: stone at eye height 2 m behind the player and a wall 3 m ahead; camera = eye - fwd*4.2 + right*0.55; CastView hits the wall ahead and Distance is about 3 m from the eye
TargetingTests.DecorIsSkippedUnlessAllowed: grass_tuft in front of a stone block; None hits the stone, Decor hits the tuft

TargetingTests.TreeCanopyNeedsAnAxeFilter: place oak_tree; a ray through the canopy (above 55% height, off the trunk column) passes with None and hits with TreeCanopy; a ray at the trunk hits with both
TargetingTests.ReachStatExtendsReach: ReachMeters grows by 1.0 m after adding the builder buff (reach +2 cells)
TargetingTests.FacingQuarterFollowsViewDirection: ViewDirection +X with Aim +Z gives quarter 3; ViewDirection null follows Aim
TargetingTests.FilterForItems: copper_axe has TreeCanopy|Decor, copper_pickaxe Decor, wooden_sword and gray_brick None
verification: Smoke basic.cmds and builder.cmds PASS (the aim command now also sets the view direction)
risks: Trees are 3x22x3-cell boxes; the trunk-column rule must match ObjectColliders exactly or axes and colliders disagree. That is why TrunkBox is shared.
Callers of the bool Cast overload (use command, inspect, TestGame.Target) keep today's behaviour by design.
